intro: Saudi Vision 2030 is the Kingdom's long-term plan to diversify its economy, develop public services and open the country to the world. It was launched on 25 April 2016 by HRH Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
The Vision is built on three pillars and 96 strategic objectives, delivered through Vision Realization Programs and large-scale giga-projects like the ones featured on this site.

pillars.title: A Vibrant Society
pillars.text: A society proud of its identity, with a better quality of life, healthcare and culture.
pillars.goal: Raise average life expectancy to 80 years

pillars.title: A Thriving Economy
pillars.text: A diverse, competitive economy that supports investment, entrepreneurs and new jobs.
pillars.goal: Grow the private sector's share of GDP from 40% to 65%

pillars.title: An Ambitious Nation
pillars.text: An effective, transparent government and citizens who take responsibility.
pillars.goal: Raise non-oil government revenue to SAR 1 trillion a year
